texts.li: Three times on the road, {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} had been told to stop here, by three people who had never met. "A warm fire, and nobody asks your business," {X_nameDef} said to {A_nameDef}, and pressed what {X_pronoun} could spare into {A_possessive} hand for the next guest.

A camp of drovers had sent {X_nameDef} this way. "They said you feed strangers and see them off with bread," {X_pronoun} told {A_nameDef}. {A_nameDef} said that was about right, and {X_nameDef} insisted on leaving something toward the next ones.
People plan their journeys around this colony now, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} over supper; its name is good on the road. {FACTION} would remember the welcome, {X_pronoun} said.

{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} asked where the colony keeps its rituals, and went to stand there a while in silence. On the road, {X_pronoun} told {A_nameDef} afterward, this is known as a place where the old words are still said properly. That night {A_nameDef} said them with more care than usual.

{X_nameDef} had heard that the colony keeps its faith, and wanted to know how: the feasts, the funerals, who leads them. {A_nameDef} told {X_objective}, and found, telling it, that {A_pronoun} believed it more than {A_pronoun} had that morning.

Before going on, {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} to say a few of the colony's words over {X_objective}. {A_nameDef} did, stumbling once, and {X_nameDef} went off down the road with {X_possessive} head still bowed.

{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} had heard that the colony keeps its days, and asked {A_nameDef} which ones and why. {A_nameDef} told {X_objective} about the founding and the dead, and got better at the telling as the evening went on.

"Is it true you mark the day of every fight you've won?" {X_nameDef} asked. "And every one of yours you've lost?" {A_nameDef} said it was, and went through them one by one, and {X_nameDef} listened to all of it.
{X_nameDef} said {FACTION} have a saying about the colony, that it never forgets a kindness or a wrong. {A_nameDef} said that was mostly true, and told {X_objective} a story to prove it.
